summary: Agentic-mesh Web Application – Authentication, Dashboard Controls, and Navigation
title: Agentic-mesh Web Application – Authentication, Dashboard Controls, and Navigation
description: The Agentic-mesh application provides a login page (home.html) where users enter email and password to sign in, a dashboard (dashboard.html) with system actions such as running diagnostics, downloading logs, and signing out, and a landing page (index.html) with a link to the home page. The flow covers authentication, session termination, and core dashboard functionalities.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the user is on the login page (home.html) and has entered a valid email and password, when the user clicks the "Sign In" button (button#submitBtn), then the user is redirected to the dashboard page (dashboard.html) and sees the "Run System Diagnostics" button
Given the user is on the dashboard page (dashboard.html), when the user clicks the "Sign Out" button (button#logoutBtn), then the user is logged out and redirected to the landing page (index.html)
Given the user is on the dashboard page (dashboard.html), when the user clicks the "Run System Diagnostics" button, then a diagnostics modal appears with the text "Diagnostics started"
Given the user is on the dashboard page (dashboard.html), when the user clicks the "Download Access Logs" button, then a file download is initiated with filename "access_logs.txt"

Given the user is on the login page (home.html), when the user clicks the toggle password button (button#togglePasswordBtn), then the password input field (input#password) changes its type from "password" to "text"
Given the user is on the landing page (index.html), when the user clicks the link labeled "home.html", then the browser navigates to the login page (home.html)
